title: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. July 2026 Dividend Announcement and June Financial Update
summary: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (NYSE: IVR) (the "Company") today announced that the Company declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share of common stock for the month of July 2026. The dividend will be paid on August 14, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on July 27, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of July 27, 2026.
